item.text: I’ll inspect `app/service.py` to update the report-writing path-building logic with an optional relative `name` parameter and then apply a focused patch that keeps the existing API when the name is omitted.
I found `app/service.py` currently rejects custom names outright; next I’ll replace that guard with optional-name handling while keeping the existing default filename when `name` is omitted.

Implemented in [`app/service.py`](/workspace/app/service.py):

- `export(...)` now accepts an optional `name` and uses it as the relative filename when provided.
- When `name` is omitted, it keeps the original behavior: `report-<id>.txt`.
- It still writes via `store.write(relative_name, body)` and returns `ExportReceipt(path=relative_name)`.

No other files were modified.
